主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. has filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 27, 2015. The filing includes Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, which are Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Results and Consolidated Financial Statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2014, respectively. The report is part of the Company's filings under Form 40-F, which is used for annual reports by foreign private issuers. The filing also includes a Consent of Deloitte LLP, an auditing firm. The report is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Company's Registration Statements on Forms S-8, F-10, F-3, and the Annual Report on Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2014. The filing is part of the Company's ongoing disclosure obligations under U.S. securities laws.
